faq.title: Sıkça sorulan sorular
faq.a1: Tüm transferler — bireysel (P2P) ve kurumsal (B2B) — için uluslararası düzenlemeler gerektiriyor. Bridge (ABD FinCEN kayıtlı MSB) yapar, OmniPay değil. Tek seferlik.
faq.a2: Bireysel transfer (P2P): Neredeyse anında — Bridge, 41+ hedef ülkeden herhangi birine dakikalar içinde ödemeyi işler. Kurumsal ödeme (B2B): 4–5 iş günü (Stripe+Wise) veya 1–2 iş günü (Bridge Wire).
faq.a3: Hayır — bireysel veya kurumsal transfer için de saklamamaktadır. Yalnızca Bridge AES-256 şifrelemesiyle işler.
faq.q4: KYC sonrası sayfayı kapatırsam ne olur?
faq.a4: P2P: Orijinal bağlantıya dönün — sistem otomatik olarak devam eder. B2B: aynı.
faq.a5: Kişisel transfer (P2P) veya B2B Wire: OmniPay %0,35 (min. $0,40–$0,75) · Bridge ~%0,75 dönüşüm · FX farkı yok. İş ödemesi B2B via Stripe+Wise: Stripe %2,9+$0,30 · Wise ~%0,8 · OmniPay %0,35+$1,99. Gerçek piyasa kurunu kullanıyoruz — gizli FX farkı yok.
faq.q6: Transfer sırasında teknik bir arıza yaşanırsa ne olur?
faq.a6: Sistem, Bridge'in nihai ödemeyi onaylamadan önce başarısız olursa, fonlar otomatik olarak gönderene iade edilir. Hiçbir şey askıda kalmaz: Bridge, alıcının doğru şekilde aldığını onaylayana kadar parayı serbest bırakmaz. Sorun devam ederse ana sayfadan destek ekibimizle iletişime geçin.

privacy.title: Gizlilik Politikası
privacy.s1_p: OmniPay Technologies Inc. ("OmniPay", "we", "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our international payment services. OmniPay operates a zero data retention architecture — we do not maintain a proprietary database of your financial information.
privacy.s2_intro: We collect only the minimum information necessary to process your transactions:
privacy.s2_li1: Name, email address, country of residence — collected to comply with KYC regulations and passed to Bridge.xyz for verification.
privacy.s2_li2: Bank account details (CLABE, IBAN, routing numbers, PIX keys) — encrypted and used only to create payment instructions. Not stored on OmniPay servers after transaction completion.
privacy.s2_li3: Amount, currency, destination country, timestamp — retained in encrypted form for 90 days for dispute resolution.
privacy.s2_li4: IP address, browser type, operating system — collected automatically for security and fraud prevention. Retained for 30 days.
privacy.s3_li1: To process and track your international transfers
privacy.s3_li2: To comply with AML/KYC regulatory requirements
privacy.s3_li3: To send transaction confirmations and receipts via SMS or WhatsApp (with your consent)
privacy.s3_li4: To detect and prevent fraud and unauthorized transactions
privacy.s3_li5: To respond to customer support inquiries
privacy.s3_li6: To improve our services (using aggregated, anonymized data only)
privacy.s4_intro: OmniPay shares your information with the following licensed service providers to fulfill transactions:
privacy.s4_bridge_desc: KYC/KYB identity verification, payment rails (SPEI, ACH, SEPA, PIX, FPS, Bre-B), customer data storage. Bridge.xyz is a licensed Money Services Business.
privacy.s4_stripe_desc: Card payment processing for B2B transfers. Stripe is PCI-DSS Level 1 certified.
privacy.s4_wise_desc: International payout fallback for countries not covered by Bridge.
privacy.s4_twilio_desc: SMS notifications for transaction confirmations (opt-in only).
privacy.s5_p: OmniPay is designed with a zero data retention principle. Your financial account details (bank accounts, card numbers, identity documents) are stored exclusively by our licensed payment processor partners, not on OmniPay servers. Payment links use AES-256-GCM encrypted tokens that contain only the minimum data needed to complete a transaction and are not stored in a database.
privacy.s6_p: We implement industry-standard security measures including TLS 1.3 encryption in transit, AES-256-GCM encryption for payment tokens, webhook signature verification (RSA-SHA256), and strict access controls. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure. We encourage you to use strong, unique passwords and report any suspected security incidents to security@omnipay.ca.
privacy.s7_intro: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to:
privacy.s7_li1: Access the personal information we hold about you
privacy.s7_li3: Request deletion of your data (subject to regulatory retention requirements)
privacy.s7_li4: Object to processing of your personal data
privacy.s7_li5: Data portability (receive your data in a structured format)
privacy.s7_contact: To exercise these rights, contact us at privacy@omnipay.ca. We will respond within 30 days.
privacy.s8_p: OmniPay uses a single functional cookie (OMNIPAY_LOCALE) to remember your preferred language. We do not use advertising cookies or third-party tracking pixels. Essential security cookies may be set by Stripe for fraud prevention during payment flows.
privacy.s9_p: Your data may be processed in Canada, the United States, and other countries where our service providers operate. By using OmniPay, you consent to the transfer of your information to these countries. We ensure appropriate safeguards are in place through Standard Contractual Clauses or equivalent mechanisms.
privacy.s10_p: OmniPay is not directed to children under 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from anyone under 18. If you believe we have inadvertently collected such information, please contact us immediately.
privacy.s11_p: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. We will notify you of significant changes by updating the "Last updated" date at the top of this page. Continued use of OmniPay after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
privacy.s12_p: Privacy inquiries: privacy@omnipay.ca | Legal inquiries: legal@omnipay.ca | Security reports: security@omnipay.ca

terms.s1_p: By accessing or using OmniPay ("Service"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, do not use the Service. OmniPay is operated by OmniPay Technologies Inc. ("Company", "we", "us").
terms.s2_p: OmniPay provides international money transfer and business payment services. We facilitate transfers between senders and recipients in supported countries using licensed third-party payment processors including Bridge.xyz, Stripe, and Wise. OmniPay does not hold, store, or manage funds directly.
terms.s3_p: You must be at least 18 years of age and legally capable of entering into contracts to use the Service. By using OmniPay, you represent that you meet these requirements and that all information you provide is accurate and complete.
terms.s4_p: To comply with applicable Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Know Your Customer (KYC) regulations, we are required to verify your identity before processing transactions. Identity verification is performed by Bridge.xyz, our licensed compliance partner. A one-time verification fee of $2.00 USD (individuals) or $10.00 USD (businesses) is charged and passed through directly to Bridge.xyz.
terms.s5_p: OmniPay charges a service fee of 0.50% of the transferred amount plus a flat operational fee ($0.99 for P2P, $1.99 for B2B transfers). Additional fees charged by payment processors (Bridge.xyz 0.75%, Stripe 2.9%+$0.30, Wise ~0.8%) are passed through transparently. All fees are disclosed before you confirm a transaction. Exchange rates are provided by Bridge.xyz and Wise and may fluctuate.
terms.s6_p: You may not use OmniPay to: (a) violate any law or regulation; (b) send funds related to illegal activities; (c) circumvent sanctions or export controls; (d) engage in money laundering, fraud, or financing of terrorism; (e) make payments to countries or individuals on OFAC sanctions lists; (f) process transactions on behalf of third parties without disclosure.
terms.s7_p: OmniPay reserves the right to impose transaction limits, require additional verification, delay, or decline transactions that we reasonably believe may violate applicable laws or our policies. We are not liable for delays caused by our payment processors or correspondent banks.
terms.s8_p: OmniPay does not maintain a proprietary database of customer financial information. All customer identity data, account details, and transaction records are stored and managed by our licensed payment processor partners (primarily Bridge.xyz). OmniPay stores only the minimum data necessary to facilitate a transaction (encrypted payment tokens that expire). We do not sell your data to third parties.
terms.s9_p: THE SERVICE IS PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTIES OF ANY KIND. OUR TOTAL LIABILITY FOR ANY CLAIM ARISING FROM THE USE OF THE SERVICE SHALL NOT EXCEED THE FEES PAID BY YOU IN THE THREE MONTHS PRECEDING THE CLAIM.
terms.s10_p: These Terms shall be governed by the laws of the Province of Ontario, Canada, without regard to conflict of law principles. Any disputes shall be resolved exclusively in the courts of Ontario, Canada.
terms.s11_p: We reserve the right to modify these Terms at any time. We will provide notice of material changes by updating the "Last updated" date. Continued use of the Service after changes constitutes acceptance of the new Terms.
